objective: Separate mere number of distinct visitor IDs from functionally new optima at fixed Model3 diploid parental state, then inspect whether a count-scaled encounter rule changes the redundancy null.
exposed_context: Designed AFTER seeing PR452's 1533 previous within-year pairs and 176/505 same-richness discordances; these fixtures are NOT independent confirmation.
source_setting: delayed_control / evolving assurance / ovule_budget 8 / original Model3 pollen formula
registered_comparisons: four_clones versus two_unique: increases visitor IDs from 2 to 4 without adding any unique optimum or altering per-type breadth/effectiveness; fixed activity predicts exact no-change in all ledger outputs (negative control)
four_distinct versus four_clones: both have 4 visitor IDs, but optima differ; measures within-ledger functional-composition intervention at fixed count
four_shifted versus four_distinct: both have 4 visitor IDs; isolates optimum-location shift with constant breadth/effectiveness
count_scaled versus fixed activity: same visitor arm and genotype; source-model activity law changes, so count and effective pollen movement may be coupled
acceptance_checks: No change to canonical Model3 biology
No visitor-history paths sampled and no source pilot RNG reused
Holding a parental state fixed across all arms
All floating and sign outputs saved, including null outcomes
Under activity_mode=fixed, duplicating both exact visitor functional types leaves viable seed ledger, finite focal beta and collective gamma invariant within 1e-9 relative tolerance
Do not interpret numerical row count as independent island-system replication or as prospective confirmation
interpretation_guardrail: The four-clones arm represents redundant visitor IDs and has TWO functional optima. Therefore changing IDs 2→4 is NOT an increase in effective niche diversity; any no-effect validates source representation, not the ecological irrelevance of richness. In count_scaled mode duplicating identical types also doubles the activity factor relative to n=2 (source law).
future_after_gate: If exploratory contrasts are stable, run pre-frozen independent visitor-type-distribution ensembles with explicit intensity and functional breadth controls, then independent ecological histories or data for external validity.
